{{Quote|The aperion includes and unites all matter, giving it shape and cohesion. Aspects of the asperion include gravity and electromagnetism&ndash;though the term encompasses everything in both space and time. Many of the abilities understood as belonging to the unifying Force tied to the aperion.|Darth Plagueis|<ref name="Book">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
The '''aperion''' was, according to [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], the part of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that included and united all matter, giving it shape and cohesion. Aspects included [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and [[Electromagnet/Legends|electromagnetism]], but encompassed all [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and [[Time/Legends|time]]. Many [[Unifying Force/Legends|Unifying Force]] abilities were tied to the aperion. The aperion was not specifically necessary for the creation and manipulation of life, but [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] channeled it nonetheless.

==Behind the scenes==
The concept of "aperion" is a reference from the [[Wikipedia:Ancient Greek|Ancient Greek]] term ἄπειρον ([[Wikipedia:Apeiron (cosmology)|''apeiron'']]), which meant "unlimited" or "infinite".<ref name="BOS endnotes">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-reads-day-special-book-of-sith-endnotes|text=Official Endnotes for Star Wars Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side (part 5)|nolive=1}}</ref> This apeiron was central to the cosmological theory of the Greek philosopher [[Wikipedia:Anaximander|Anaximander]].
